sources.title: ml-sharp — rcarmo
sources.snippet: Forked from apple/ml-sharp. Adds Apple Silicon MPS support and Gradio demo to Apple's official Sharp depth model. ml-sharp runs the Sharp monocular depth estimation and novel view synthesis pipeline natively on Apple Silicon using PyTorch MPS acceleration. Feed it a single image and it produces depth maps and synthesised views from alternative camera angles — no NVIDIA GPU, no cloud API ...
